purpose: Validate an actual one-degree ordinary setpoint change through stock VS1/F4 and exact restoration.

target.name: ordinary day room setpoint
target.target_policy: baseline +1 C unless baseline is 30 C, then baseline -1 C

sequence: Stop Party if active and stop splitter for exclusive serial access.
Write bounded target by stock F4.
After 250 ms verify target by F7.
In cleanup, after any change-write attempt, write exact baseline via F4 with up to two restore attempts.
Return to P300, verify 00F8/2=20C2 and 2306/1 equals original baseline.
Restore splitter and Party service state.
safety_boundary: Only ordinary user setpoint 0x2306 is changed.
Maximum intentional delta is exactly 1 C.
No coding, EEPROM, GFA_WRITE, PROCESS_WRITE, burner, gas-valve, actuator or safety write is implemented.
Restore is attempted even if validation after the target write fails.
interpretation: PASS would establish actual state mutation and exact restoration through stock VS1/F4 on this appliance, removing the remaining transport-level blocker to permanent VS1 with existing ordinary writable HA entities.

conclusion: Stock VS1/F4 performed an actual one-byte value mutation on ordinary setpoint 0x2306: 21 C -> 22 C.
F7 immediately confirmed the changed value.
Stock VS1/F4 restored the exact original byte on the first restore attempt and F7 confirmed 21 C.
P300 was re-established and independently confirmed 0x2306=21 C after the restore.
F4 response payload remained 00 for both change and restore and is not an echo of the written value.

profile_write_width_audit.conclusion: All currently exposed Optolink-backed writable controls in the live VDensHO1 HA profile resolve to one-byte datapoints.
profile_write_width_audit.time_programs: 8-byte schedules are read-only in the current live HA profile.
profile_write_width_audit.caveat: Some service/config control values are source-documented R/W but have not all been semantically hardware-tested on this exact appliance. The F4 result validates transport/width, not every coding's appliance-specific effect.

next_gate: One final real-splitter write-path smoke under temporary permanent VS1, using the splitter request dispatcher rather than direct optolinkvs1 calls, before enabling permanent VS1 and updater-managed GFA polling.
